scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/client" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/client && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('apps/client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}))"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/client
